teaser.en: Its round fruits grow as big as a cannonball, then crack apart into a puzzle of wedge-shaped seeds that the tide carries away.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake ya mviringo hukua makubwa kama gunduli la mzinga, kisha hupasuka na kuwa mbegu zenye umbo la kabari zinazoshikamana kama fumbo, nazo huchukuliwa na maji ya bahari.

teaser.en: Dhow builders prized its timber for masts, yet this rare mangrove hides in the thickets at the back of the swamp, away from the sea.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa majahazi waliuthamini mti huu kwa ajili ya milingoti, lakini mkoko huu adimu hujificha vichakani nyuma ya bwawa, mbali na bahari.

teaser.en: Turn over one of its leaves and you see why it is called the looking-glass mangrove: the underside shines silver-white.
teaser.sw: Geuza moja ya majani yake na utaona kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa mkoko wa kioo: upande wa chini hung'aa kwa rangi nyeupe ya fedha.

teaser.en: Its white powder-puff flowers open only at night, and its light breathing roots have long served fishermen as net floats.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe yanayofanana na pamba ya poda huchanua usiku tu, na mizizi yake myepesi ya kupumulia imewatumikia wavuvi kwa muda mrefu kama vielelezo vya nyavu.

teaser.en: Its seed sprouts while still hanging on the tree, and its hollow trunks have been turned into drums and beehives.
teaser.sw: Mbegu yake huota ikiwa bado inaning'inia mtini, na mashina yake yenye mvungu yamegeuzwa kuwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki.
teaser.dg: Tembeye inamera ichiri inabwadzika kpwa muhi, na makologe mahuphu gakahendwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi.

teaser.en: Its Digo name calls it a mangrove of the mainland, yet the Digo do not count it among the mangroves at all.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mkoko wa bara, lakini Wadigo hawauhesabu kabisa miongoni mwa mikoko.

swahili: Mkoko (Mgombato also gives msinzi, msizi, mshinzi)

teaser.en: Mangrove poles were once counted in scores, and most of them came from this tree standing on its arching stilt roots.
teaser.sw: Zamani boriti za mikoko zilihesabiwa kwa korija, na nyingi zilitoka kwa mti huu uliosimama juu ya mizizi yake ya mapindi.
teaser.dg: Kare mihi ya mikoko kala inaolangbwa kpwa makorija, na minji kala inalavywa kula muhi uhu unaoima dzulu ya miziye iriyootyoka.

teaser.en: Its leaves sweat salt you can see and taste, and the bao boards and mortars of the coast are often carved from its wood.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hutoa jasho la chumvi unaloweza kuliona na kulionja, na mbao za bao na vinu vya pwani mara nyingi huchongwa kwa mbao zake.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganalavya munyu unaoweza kuuona na kuuonja, na mabao na vinu vya pwani kpwa kawaida nkutsongbwa kula kpwa nyama za muhi uhu.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means roughly 'the one that bends towards the sea', and on the coral shore it leans just that way.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya takriban 'unaoinamia bahari', na katika ufuo wa matumbawe huinama hivyo hasa.

teaser.en: Its flowers hang in long strings of pink and white puffs that open at dusk and lie scattered on the water by morning.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu ya vishada vya waridi na vyeupe vinavyochanua jioni, na kufikia asubuhi huwa yametapakaa juu ya maji.

teaser.en: Bite a leaf and you taste the sea: this succulent shrub is so salty that only hardy livestock will browse it.
teaser.sw: Ng'ata jani lake na utaonja bahari: kichaka hiki chenye majani manono kina chumvi nyingi kiasi kwamba ni mifugo hodari tu wanaokila.

teaser.en: A mangrove found mainly on Kenya's south coast, more often a shrub than a tree, with neat white flowers at the high-water mark.
teaser.sw: Mkoko unaopatikana hasa katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya, mara nyingi kichaka kuliko mti, wenye maua meupe maridadi kwenye alama ya maji makuu.

teaser.en: Builders say no mangrove pole lasts longer, and its bark is so rich in tannin that nearly half its weight can go into dye.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa ujenzi husema hakuna boriti ya mkoko inayodumu kuliko yake, na gome lake lina tanini nyingi kiasi kwamba karibu nusu ya uzito wake unaweza kutumika kwa rangi.

teaser.en: Its runners stitch the sand dunes together, and each leaf is split at the tip like the print of a goat's hoof.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake yanayotambaa huyashona matuta ya mchanga pamoja, na kila jani limegawanyika kwenye ncha kama alama ya kwato ya mbuzi.

teaser.en: Its flowers look torn in half, with all the petals on one side, as if someone had picked away the rest.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yanaonekana kama yamechanwa nusu, petali zote zikiwa upande mmoja, kana kwamba mtu amezichuma nyingine.

teaser.en: Village farmers at Kibuyuni grow it on lines in the shallow sea, then sell it to the makers of toothpaste and ice cream.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa kijijini huko Kibuyuni huukuza kwenye kamba katika bahari isiyo na kina, kisha huuuzia watengenezaji wa dawa ya meno na aiskrimu.

teaser.en: Its flowers are so fragrant that cooks steep them in coconut milk, and its spiny leaves are woven into mats and baskets.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yana harufu nzuri kiasi kwamba wapishi huyaloweka katika tui la nazi, na majani yake yenye miiba husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu.
teaser.dg: Maruwage gana arufu nono sana hata ajiti nkugatiya kpwenye huwi, na makodzage genye miya nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango.

teaser.en: Its white flowers open at night and fall by morning, filling the beach air with scent while most people are asleep.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe huchanua usiku na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi, yakijaza hewa ya ufuoni harufu nzuri wakati watu wengi wamelala.

teaser.en: Before kerosene reached the coast, the oily seeds of this shady beach tree were pressed to light lamps.
teaser.sw: Kabla mafuta ya taa hayajafika pwani, mbegu zenye mafuta za mti huu wenye kivuli wa ufuoni zilikamuliwa ili kuwasha taa.

english: Indian almond, bastard almond, tropical almond

teaser.en: Its giant leaves wrap food, its nuts taste of almond, and before falling the leaves turn a flaming red.
teaser.sw: Majani yake makubwa mno hufungia chakula, kokwa zake zina ladha ya lozi, na kabla ya kupukutika majani hugeuka mekundu kama moto.

english: Whistling pine, beach she-oak, horsetail tree

teaser.en: Stand under one on a windy day at Diani and you will hear why it is called the whistling pine.
teaser.sw: Simama chini yake siku yenye upepo huko Diani na utasikia kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *whistling pine*, 'msonobari unaopiga mluzi'.
teaser.dg: Ima photsize siku ya phepho uchikala Diani, nawe undasikira sababu unaoihwa *whistling pine*.

teaser.en: A flowering plant that lives its whole life underwater, it feeds dugongs and shelters the fish that Digo fishers catch.
teaser.sw: Ni mmea unaotoa maua na kuishi maisha yake yote chini ya maji; huwalisha nguva na kuwahifadhi samaki wanaovuliwa na wavuvi wa Kidigo.

teaser.en: Its leaves are perfectly round, like strands of spaghetti waving under the sea.
teaser.sw: Majani yake ni ya mviringo kamili, kama nyuzi za tambi zinazopepea chini ya bahari.

teaser.en: Its flowers open yellow like a hibiscus in the morning and fade to purple by evening.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huchanua asubuhi yakiwa ya manjano kama ya haibiskasi, na kufikia jioni hufifia kuwa ya zambarau.

teaser.en: Walk out on the lagoon flats at low tide and the soft green carpet underfoot is often this underwater flowering plant.
teaser.sw: Tembea kwenye nyanda za mahori wakati wa maji kupwa, na zulia laini la kijani lililo chini ya miguu yako mara nyingi ni mmea huu unaotoa maua chini ya maji.

teaser.en: Unlike most seagrasses, it grows woody stems that rise from the seabed, carrying fans of curved leaves like little underwater palms.
teaser.sw: Tofauti na nyasi bahari nyingi, huotesha mashina magumu kama mti yanayoinuka kutoka sakafu ya bahari, yakibeba mapepeo ya majani yaliyopinda kama minazi midogo chini ya maji.

teaser.en: At Kibuyuni, women who were traditionally kept from fishing now farm the sea, and turn their seaweed into soap, lotion and juice.
teaser.sw: Huko Kibuyuni, wanawake ambao kwa desturi walizuiwa kuvua samaki sasa hulima bahari, na hugeuza mwani wao kuwa sabuni, losheni na sharubati.

teaser.en: Its ribbon leaves can grow a metre long, streaming in the tide like green tape in the shallow lagoons.
teaser.sw: Majani yake kama riboni yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita moja, yakielea na maji kama utepe wa kijani katika mahori yasiyo na kina.

teaser.en: Green turtles graze on it like cattle on a pasture, cropping the underwater meadows of the south coast.
teaser.sw: Kasa huila kama ng'ombe malishoni, wakizikata mbuga za chini ya maji za pwani ya kusini.

teaser.en: A doum palm in miniature, it often grows with no trunk at all, its fan leaves rising straight from the sand.
teaser.sw: Ni mkoma mdogo kabisa; mara nyingi hukua bila shina hata kidogo, na majani yake ya umbo la pepeo huchipuka moja kwa moja kutoka mchangani.
teaser.dg: Ni dza mkoma mdide sana, na mara nyinji tachina kolo kabisa: makodzage dza chiphephero ganamera chocho kula mtsangani.

teaser.en: Unusually for a palm, it branches, and its leaf strips are behind one of the best-known Digo plant names: *mlala*.
teaser.sw: Jambo lisilo la kawaida kwa mchikichi, mti huu hutoa matawi, na vipande vya majani yake ndivyo chanzo cha mojawapo ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayojulikana zaidi: *mlala*.
teaser.dg: Si dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi, uhu una panda, na vipande vya makodzage ndivyo vinavyoreha dzina ra mmea ririromanyikana zaidi kpwa Chidigo: *mlala*.

teaser.en: The Digo have a name for every stage of a coconut, from the tiny *kolokotsi* to the overripe *nguta*: seven in all.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wana jina kwa kila hatua ya nazi, kuanzia *kolokotsi* ndogo kabisa hadi *nguta* iliyokomaa kupita kiasi: majina saba kwa jumla.
teaser.dg: Adigo ana dzina kpwa chila hatua ya kukula kpwa nazi, kula *kolokotsi* ndide hadi *nguta* iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi: madzina sabaa gosi.

teaser.en: When the sun sets during Ramadan, many Digo households break the fast the traditional way: with a date.
teaser.sw: Jua linapozama wakati wa Ramadhani, kaya nyingi za Wadigo hufuturu kwa njia ya jadi: kwa tende.
teaser.dg: Dzuwa richitswa wakati wa Ramadhani, mbari nyinji za Adigo nkuvugula kpwa njira ya chimila: kpwa tende.

teaser.en: In the wet valleys below the Shimba Hills grows a wild relative of the palm that fills supermarket shelves worldwide with oil.
teaser.sw: Katika mabonde yenye maji chini ya Milima ya Shimba huota ndugu wa porini wa mchikichi unaojaza rafu za maduka makubwa duniani kote kwa mafuta.

teaser.en: Its leaves can reach eight metres, among the longest in the plant world, and its young leaflets give the raffia used for mats and string.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanaweza kufikia mita nane, miongoni mwa majani marefu zaidi katika ulimwengu wa mimea, na vijani vyake vichanga hutoa nyuzi za raffia zinazotumika kwa mikeka na kamba.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganaweza kufika mita nane, ni kahi ya makodza mare zaidi ga mimea yosi duniani, na makodza madide matsanga ganalavya mlala unaohumirwa kuhenda majamvi na nyugbwe.

teaser.en: Its trunk swells out halfway up like a bottle, and its seedlings are dug up and eaten as a vegetable.
teaser.sw: Shina lake huvimba katikati kama chupa, na miche yake huchimbuliwa na kuliwa kama mboga.
teaser.dg: Kolore rinavwimba kahi-kahi dza tupa, na mitseye nkufukulwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

teaser.en: Its leaves are woven into the mats called *ukuti wa uchindu*, and its little orange dates are a riverside snack.
teaser.sw: Majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka inayoitwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tende zake ndogo za rangi ya machungwa ni kitafunio cha kando ya mto.
teaser.dg: Makodzage nkusukwa majamvi ganagoihwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tendeze ndide za rangi ya chungbwa ni chakurya cha kanda-kanda ya miho.

teaser.en: A tree of rocky coastal places whose white pea-flowers give way to flat woody pods, and whose Digo name depends on whom you ask.
teaser.sw: Mti wa maeneo ya miamba ya pwani ambao maua yake meupe kama ya kunde hufuatwa na maganda bapa magumu, na ambao jina lake la Kidigo hutegemea unamuuliza nani.

teaser.en: A little-known tree of the coastal woodlands, listed as Vulnerable, with lopsided paired leaflets and short warty pods.
teaser.sw: Mti usiojulikana sana wa misitu ya pwani, ulioorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini, wenye vijani vya jozi visivyolingana pande na maganda mafupi yenye vidutu.

teaser.en: Its name comes from *uganga*, healing, yet its white sap is so poisonous that a drop in the eye is dangerous.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *uganga*, yaani tiba, lakini utomvu wake mweupe una sumu kali kiasi kwamba tone moja jichoni ni hatari.

teaser.en: Its black seeds wear bright red-orange caps, strung into necklaces, while its termite-proof poles hold up the main frame of a house.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake nyeusi zina vifuniko vyekundu-machungwa vinavyong'aa na hutungwa kuwa mikufu, huku nguzo zake zisizoliwa na mchwa zikishikilia fremu kuu ya nyumba.
teaser.dg: Tembeze nyiru zina kofiya za rangi ya kundu na ya chungbwa inayong'arira, na nkutungwa kuhenda mikufu; nazo nguzoze, ambazo taziriwa ni lutswa, nkuimisa muundo mkulu wa nyumba.

teaser.en: Its ripe fruit is eaten fresh, dried or fermented into a drink, and its dark wood resists both fungus and termites.
teaser.sw: Tunda lake lililoiva huliwa likiwa bichi, lililokaushwa au likiwa limechachushwa kuwa kinywaji, na mbao zake nyeusi hustahimili kuvu na mchwa.

teaser.en: One of its Digo names means 'forest breaker', for the way it pushes up through the canopy and towers over the trees around it.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana ya 'mvunja msitu', kwa jinsi unavyochomoza katikati ya kilele cha msitu na kuipita miti inayouzunguka.

teaser.en: Its name and its main use are one and the same: *mdege* is medicine against *dege*, the evil eye.
teaser.sw: Jina lake na matumizi yake makuu ni kitu kimoja: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*, jicho baya.

teaser.en: Healers in Diani boil its bark and leaves together for malaria, and its zig-zag young stems make it easy to recognise.
teaser.sw: Waganga wa Diani huchemsha gome na majani yake pamoja kutibu malaria, na vitawi vyake vichanga vinavyopinda-pinda huufanya kuwa rahisi kuutambua.

teaser.en: Its trunk is studded with corky knobs, each tipped with a prickle, and its crushed leaves smell of lemon.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa vinundu vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na mwiba ncha yake, na majani yake yakipondwa hunukia kama limau.

teaser.en: Its branches grow in threes, perfect for the three-pronged stick used to stir porridge, and the tree is named after it.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hukua matatu matatu, kamili kwa mwiko wa ncha tatu wa kusongea uji, na mti huu umepewa jina kutokana nao.

teaser.en: Its Digo name adds *madzi*, water, because its fruit is juicier than that of its cousin, the plain *mfudu*.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linaongeza *madzi*, maji, kwa sababu tunda lake lina maji mengi kuliko la binamu yake, *mfudu* wa kawaida.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'floury *mfudu*', because its purple-black fruit is mealier and starchier than the ordinary kind.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya '*mfudu* wa unga', kwa sababu tunda lake la zambarau-nyeusi lina unga na wanga zaidi kuliko la aina ya kawaida.

teaser.en: Its black, mealy fruits taste sweet enough to earn it the English name chocolate berry.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake meusi yenye unga-unga ni matamu kiasi cha kuupatia jina la Kiingereza *chocolate berry*.

teaser.en: Its bark is so smooth and powdery that, people say, even monkeys struggle to climb it.
teaser.sw: Gome lake ni laini na lenye unga-unga kiasi kwamba, watu husema, hata nyani hupata shida kuupanda.

teaser.en: Before felling a giant fig like this, tree cutters might first sacrifice a black sheep to the spirits living inside it.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya kuangusha mkuyu mkubwa kama huu, wakataji miti wanaweza kwanza kuchinja kondoo mweusi kama sadaka kwa pepo wanaoishi ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya kukata muhi mkulu wa kuyu dza hinyu, akata mihi anaweza kulavya sadaka ya ng'ondzi mwiru kpwa pepho anaokala ndaniwe.

teaser.en: Its pink trumpet flowers hang in fragrant sprays, yet its Swahili name, mti sumu, means 'poison tree'.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta huning'inia kwa vishada vyenye harufu nzuri, lakini jina lake la Kiswahili, mti sumu, lina maana ya 'mti wa sumu'.

teaser.en: Its star-shaped fruits look handsome but hide itchy hairs, while its bark gives the rope that ties roofs together.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye umbo la nyota yanapendeza kuyaona lakini yanaficha manyoya yanayowasha, na gome lake hutoa kamba inayofunga mapaa.

teaser.en: People once wore this tree: its bark was beaten into cloth, which is how it earned one of its Digo names.
teaser.sw: Zamani watu waliuvaa mti huu: gome lake lilipigwa likawa nguo, na hivyo ndivyo lilivyopata mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.

teaser.en: A screw pine that stands on stilts beside creeks, with spiny leaves long enough to weave into mats.
teaser.sw: Mkadi unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili kando ya mikondo ya bahari, wenye majani yenye miiba marefu kiasi cha kusukwa mikeka.

teaser.en: One of its Digo names simply means 'trap', because that is what its sticks become.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana ya 'mtego' tu, kwa sababu hivyo ndivyo vijiti vyake vinavyogeuka kuwa.

teaser.en: A forest giant with buttresses climbing its trunk, whose big plum-like fruit and oily seeds feed people and livestock alike.
teaser.sw: Jitu la msituni lenye mizizi-ukuta inayopanda juu ya shina lake, ambalo tunda lake kubwa kama plamu na mbegu zake zenye mafuta hulisha watu na mifugo pia.

teaser.en: Termites can't eat its black heartwood, and one of its Digo names says the baboons got there first.
teaser.sw: Mchwa hawawezi kula kiini chake cheusi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linasema nyani walifika kwanza.

teaser.en: Cut any part of this tree and it bleeds blood-red sap, and the Digo of Diani boil its bark against malaria.
teaser.sw: Kata sehemu yoyote ya mti huu nao utatoa utomvu mwekundu kama damu, na Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome lake kutibu malaria.

teaser.en: Crack its hard round shell and you find sweet orange pulp, one of the bushland's wild treats.
teaser.sw: Vunja ganda lake gumu la mviringo nawe utakuta nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa, mojawapo ya vitafunio vya porini vya vichakani.

teaser.en: A dark-barked ebony cousin of the coastal grasslands, cut for poles and recognised by leaves that are rusty underneath.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa eboni mwenye gome jeusi wa nyika za pwani, unaokatwa kwa nguzo na kutambulika kwa majani yenye rangi ya kutu upande wa chini.

teaser.en: Its flowers and fruit hang in long sprays straight from old wood, and the fruit tastes as good as it looks.
teaser.sw: Maua na matunda yake huning'inia kwa vishada virefu moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye mti mkongwe, na tunda lake ni tamu kama linavyopendeza kuliona.

teaser.en: A smooth-barked timber tree common in the coast's forests, with leaflets that are lopsided, one side wider than the other.
teaser.sw: Mti wa mbao wenye gome laini unaopatikana kwa wingi katika misitu ya pwani, wenye vijani vilivyopinda, upande mmoja mpana kuliko mwingine.

teaser.en: Its figs grow in heavy bunches straight from the trunk, turning red when they are ready to eat.
teaser.sw: Tini zake hukua kwa vichala vizito moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina, zikigeuka nyekundu zinapokuwa tayari kuliwa.

teaser.en: Its frilly, purple-spotted flowers hang down like orchids, among the showiest in the coastal forest.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yenye mapindo na madoa ya zambarau huning'inia kama okidi, miongoni mwa maua ya kuvutia zaidi katika msitu wa pwani.

teaser.en: Its name means 'whip', and its branches are wielded as magical whips against enemies.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mjeledi', na matawi yake hutumiwa kama mijeledi ya uchawi dhidi ya maadui.

teaser.en: A 'whip of sacred powers': a stick of this tree is said to punish offenders and open closed homes and graves.
teaser.sw: 'Mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu': inasemekana fimbo ya mti huu huwaadhibu wakosaji na kufungua nyumba na makaburi yaliyofungwa.

teaser.en: A buttressed timber giant of lowland forest whose winged seeds sail out of long flat pods, now officially Vulnerable.
teaser.sw: Jitu la mbao lenye mizizi-ukuta la misitu ya nyanda za chini ambalo mbegu zake zenye mabawa hupeperuka kutoka kwenye maganda marefu bapa, na sasa limeorodheshwa rasmi kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).

teaser.en: Its leaves bunch at the tips of stubby side-shoots, and its small berries are a sweet find in dry bush.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hujikusanya kwenye ncha za machipukizi mafupi ya pembeni, na matunda yake madogo ni tunu tamu katika vichaka vikavu.

teaser.en: Its timber shrugs off seawater, so it went into dhows, piers and mallets; its name means 'across the river'.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake hazidhuriwi na maji ya bahari, hivyo zilitumika kwa majahazi, gati na nyundo za mbao; jina lake lina maana ya 'ng'ambo ya mto'.

teaser.en: Marula nuts are so hard to open that a whole Digo plant is named for picking them out with its thorns.
teaser.sw: Kokwa za mng'ong'o ni ngumu sana kufungua kiasi kwamba mmea mzima wa Kidigo umepewa jina kwa kuzitoa kwa miiba yake.

teaser.en: It looks like a wild pawpaw, and its wood dries so quickly that its name means 'drying'.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na mpapai wa porini, na mbao zake hukauka haraka mno hivi kwamba jina lake linamaanisha 'kukauka'.

teaser.en: One of Kenya's rarest trees hides in the Shimba Hills and Kwale kayas, its white flowers on extraordinarily long tubes.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa miti adimu kabisa nchini Kenya umejificha katika milima ya Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale, ukiwa na maua meupe yaliyo kwenye mirija mirefu ajabu.

teaser.en: Red flower balls dangle on long strings below its flat crown, and in hard times its seeds kept people alive.
teaser.sw: Mipira ya maua mekundu huning'inia kwenye kamba ndefu chini ya kilele chake bapa, na nyakati za shida mbegu zake ziliokoa maisha ya watu.

teaser.en: Its inner bark becomes string and baskets, its fruit is a snack, and its trunk becomes mortars and beehives.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la ndani hugeuka kamba na vikapu, tunda lake ni kitafunio, na shina lake hugeuka vinu na mizinga ya nyuki.

teaser.en: Called the wild mango, it is actually a bean-family tree whose yellow fruit is eaten raw or cooked.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kiingereza huitwa embe la porini, lakini kwa kweli ni mti wa jamii ya kunde ambao tunda lake la njano huliwa bichi au likipikwa.

teaser.en: The wooden sandals once worn along the Swahili coast were carved from this tree, and its name remembers them.
teaser.sw: Viatu vya mbao vilivyovaliwa zamani katika pwani ya Waswahili vilichongwa kutoka mti huu, na jina lake linavikumbuka.

teaser.en: Don't burn it: its smoke is said to give you sores in the nose, which is exactly what its name means.
teaser.sw: Usiuchome: inasemekana moshi wake huleta vidonda puani, na hiyo ndiyo hasa maana ya jina lake.

teaser.en: It grows into thickets so dense that one Digo name means 'closing pile': it shuts the path.
teaser.sw: Huota na kuwa vichaka vizito mno hivi kwamba mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linamaanisha 'rundo linalofunga': hufunga njia.

teaser.en: Its name comes from upesi, 'quickly', because few trees fill a forest gap faster.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na upesi, kwa sababu ni miti michache inayojaza pengo la msitu kwa haraka kuliko huu.

teaser.en: The purple-black wood of this scrubby little tree ends up in clarinets and oboes on the world's concert stages.
teaser.sw: Mbao ya rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi ya mti huu mdogo wa vichakani huishia kuwa klarineti na obo katika majukwaa ya muziki duniani.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi hinyu mdide wa chitsaka, za rangi ya zambarau-iru, nkuhumirwa kuhenda *clarinet* na *oboe* zinazochezwa kpwenye majukwaa ga muziki duniani kosi.

teaser.en: Its very scientific name, anthelmintica, means 'worm-expelling', and that is exactly what its bark is used for.
teaser.sw: Hata jina lake la kisayansi, anthelmintica, linamaanisha 'kinachofukuza minyoo', na hivyo ndivyo hasa gome lake linavyotumika.

teaser.en: Its branches become pestles, and one of its Digo names, mutsi, simply means 'pestle'.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hugeuka michi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo, mutsi, linamaanisha 'mchi' tu.

teaser.en: Pick up a piece of its wood and you'll understand the name: mremero means 'heavy'.
teaser.sw: Okota kipande cha mbao zake na utaelewa jina lake: mremero linamaanisha 'nzito'.

teaser.en: When its new leaves unfold, the woodland blushes pink and scarlet before turning green.
teaser.sw: Majani yake mapya yanapochipuka, pori hugeuka rangi ya waridi na nyekundu iliyokolea kabla ya kuwa kijani.

teaser.en: Blue-to-mauve flowers with one big petal set this tree apart, though it shares its Digo name with the msasa.
teaser.sw: Maua ya rangi ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu yenye petali moja kubwa huutofautisha mti huu, ingawa unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo na myombo.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'food of kpwembe', after the bird said to eat its fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linamaanisha 'chakula cha kpwembe', kwa kumfuata ndege anayesemekana kula matunda yake.

teaser.en: Its leaves are so rough that carvers use them as sandpaper, and its name means just that.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanakwaruza mno hivi kwamba wachongaji huyatumia kama msasa, na jina lake linamaanisha hivyo hasa.

english: Gum copal tree, East African copal

teaser.en: Its gum once lights homes at night and keeps pests out of the maize store.
teaser.sw: Sandarusi yake huwasha mwanga majumbani usiku na kuzuia wadudu ghalani mwa mahindi.

teaser.en: Children go looking for its fruit, while carpenters want its hard red-yellow heartwood for pestles and mortars.
teaser.sw: Watoto huenda kutafuta matunda yake, nao maseremala hutaka kiini chake kigumu chekundu-njano kwa michi na vinu.

teaser.en: Carpenters can pick out its planks by smell alone, and the Digo call it the 'elephant' of its kind.
teaser.sw: Maseremala wanaweza kuzitambua mbao zake kwa harufu peke yake, na Wadigo huuita 'ndovu' wa aina yake.

teaser.en: The 'small mtsani' has fern-like leaves and a flat crown, and carpenters still count it among their timbers.
teaser.sw: 'Mtsani mdogo' una majani kama ya kangaga na kilele bapa, na maseremala bado huuhesabu miongoni mwa mbao zao.

teaser.en: Its leaves look like a camel's footprint, its pods lather like soap, and it is used to make a person admired.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanafanana na unyayo wa ngamia, maganda yake hutoa povu kama sabuni, na hutumika kumfanya mtu apendwe na kusifiwa.

teaser.en: Eat the ripe pulp, never the seeds, then dry the shell and you have a musical rattle.
teaser.sw: Kula nyama ya tunda lililoiva, kamwe si mbegu, kisha kausha ganda lake na utapata kayamba la muziki.

teaser.en: Second only to African blackwood for carving, this fragrant wood has become so scarce that carvers may cut only a few trees.
teaser.sw: Kwa uchongaji, ni wa pili tu baada ya mpingo; mbao hii yenye harufu nzuri imekuwa adimu kiasi kwamba wachongaji wanaruhusiwa kukata miti michache tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa kutsonga, mbao zenye arufu nono za muhi uhu zinatsupwa ni mphingo tu, na sambi ni adimu hata atu anaotsonga anaruhusiwa kukata mihi michache tu.

teaser.en: Bright yellow flowers, then pods so long and dark they hang like walking sticks from the branches.
teaser.sw: Maua ya njano angavu, kisha maganda marefu na meusi kiasi kwamba yananing'inia kutoka matawini kama fimbo za kutembelea.

teaser.en: Its shiny leaves turn black when dried, and its black fruits wear a little red cap.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanayong'aa hugeuka meusi yakikauka, na matunda yake meusi huvaa kofia ndogo nyekundu.

teaser.en: The 'water drinker' keeps its feet by the river, and its scarlet-and-black seeds give a prized oil yet are deadly poisonous.
teaser.sw: 'Mnywa maji' huweka miguu yake kando ya mto, na mbegu zake nyekundu na nyeusi hutoa mafuta yanayothaminiwa, ingawa ni sumu kali.

teaser.en: Before iron nails came from abroad, there was the 'hinterland nail': pegs cut from this tree's hard wood.
teaser.sw: Kabla misumari ya chuma haijaletwa kutoka ng'ambo, kulikuwa na 'msumari wa bara': vigingi vilivyochongwa kutoka mbao ngumu za mti huu.

teaser.en: Its giant sausage-shaped fruits hang on rope-like stalks and are used to ferment traditional beer.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake makubwa mno yenye umbo la soseji huning'inia kwenye mashina kama kamba na hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji.

teaser.en: Carpenters know a mvure plank by its smell, and its timber is so prized that the tree is now rare in Kenya.
teaser.sw: Maseremala hutambua ubao wa mvure kwa harufu yake, na mbao zake zinathaminiwa sana kiasi kwamba mti huu sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya.
teaser.dg: Mafundi a mbao nkumanya libao ra *mvure* kpwa arufuye, na mbao za muhi uhu zina samani kulu hata sambi ukakala adimu Kenya.

teaser.en: Its name means 'drum maker': the soft, light trunk of this scarlet-flowered tree is hollowed out to make drum bodies.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linamaanisha 'mtengeneza ngoma': shina laini na jepesi la mti huu wenye maua mekundu angavu hufukuliwa ndani ili kutengeneza viunzi vya ngoma.

teaser.en: Termites leave its wood alone, so coastal builders reach for this spiny, layered tree when they need house poles that last.
teaser.sw: Mchwa hawazigusi mbao zake, kwa hiyo wajenzi wa pwani huukimbilia mti huu wenye miiba na matawi ya ngazi wanapohitaji nguzo za nyumba zinazodumu.

teaser.en: This riverside giant carries the name of a spirit, and healers turn to it for the illnesses that spirit is said to cause.
teaser.sw: Jitu hili la kando ya mito linabeba jina la pepo, na waganga hulitegemea kutibu maradhi yanayosemekana kusababishwa na pepo huyo.

teaser.en: It flowers straight from its trunk and is named after two spirits, Mwanga and Jine, whose ailments it is used to treat.
teaser.sw: Hutoa maua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina lake, na umepewa jina la pepo wawili, Mwanga na Jine, ambao maradhi yao hutibiwa kwa mti huu.

teaser.en: A buttressed forest tree with smooth dark bark whose reddish fruits are worth the walk when ripe.
teaser.sw: Mti wa msituni wenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini jeusi, ambao matunda yake mekundu yanastahili safari ya kuyafuata yakiiva.

teaser.en: The 'forest mango' looks like a mango tree that wandered into the woods, but cut a leaf and white latex appears.
teaser.sw: 'Mwembe wa msituni' unaonekana kama mwembe uliopotea ukaingia porini, lakini ukikata jani, utomvu mweupe hutoka.

teaser.en: Purple-stained fingers give away anyone who has been eating water berries straight from the tree.
teaser.sw: Vidole vilivyotiwa rangi ya zambarau humwumbua yeyote aliyekuwa akila zambarau moja kwa moja kutoka mtini.

teaser.en: Its violet flowers smell sweet, but it is the roots of this small bush tree that Diani healers dig up for malaria.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya urujuani yananukia vizuri, lakini ni mizizi ya mti huu mdogo wa porini ambayo waganga wa Diani huichimba kwa ajili ya malaria.

teaser.en: Named for the deep shade it throws, this forest tree hides bright red fruits that are best admired and not eaten.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na kivuli kizito unachotoa, na mti huu wa msituni huficha matunda mekundu yanayong'aa ambayo ni bora kuyatazama kuliko kuyala.

teaser.en: Hunters once used the sticky milk of this hairy fig as glue, fixing feathers onto arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Zamani wawindaji walitumia utomvu unaonata wa mkuyu huu wenye manyoya kama gundi, kubandika manyoya ya ndege kwenye mishale.

teaser.en: Corky knobs tipped with spines cover its stems, which makes it a fine living fence and a well-known malaria remedy.
teaser.sw: Vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye ncha za miiba hufunika mashina yake, jambo linaloufanya kuwa ua hai mzuri na dawa inayojulikana ya malaria.

teaser.en: The Digo call it 'the acacia with claws', and anyone caught in its hooked thorns will understand why.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanakiita 'mgunga wenye kucha', na yeyote aliyenaswa na miiba yake iliyopinda kama ndoano ataelewa kwa nini.

teaser.en: Its flowers smell so sweet that they are woven into wedding wreaths and used to make perfume.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yananukia vizuri kiasi kwamba husukwa katika mashada ya maua ya harusi na hutumika kutengeneza manukato.

teaser.en: Its name means 'smile', and it is used as a charm to win the warmth and goodwill of friends and workmates.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'tabasamu', na hutumika kama hirizi ya kupata upendo na nia njema ya marafiki na wafanyakazi wenzako.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf of horsewood and a strong aniseed-like smell fills the air, which is how healers know they have the right plant.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani la *chinyapala* na harufu kali kama ya binzari tamu (anise) hujaa hewani; hivyo ndivyo waganga wanavyojua kwamba wamepata mmea sahihi.

teaser.en: Called the 'crown of honour', this bush legume is used in charms meant to raise a person above their rivals.
teaser.sw: Kikiitwa 'taji la heshima', kichaka hiki cha jamii ya kunde hutumika katika hirizi zinazokusudiwa kumwinua mtu juu ya wapinzani wake.

teaser.en: Its name means 'peel off', a warning about the burning white latex that can make skin blister and peel.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kuchubuka', onyo kuhusu utomvu mweupe unaounguza ambao unaweza kufanya ngozi itoke malengelenge na kuchubuka.

teaser.en: Its papery green bark peels like old paint, and its fragrant resin is chewed, carved into, and used on arrows.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la kijani kama karatasi hubanduka kama rangi kuukuu, na utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri hutafunwa, huchongwa, na hutumika kwenye mishale.

teaser.en: The 'big rib plant' is used against convulsions that are said to grip the rib cage.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mkubwa wa mbavu' hutumika dhidi ya degedege linalosemekana kubana mbavu.

teaser.en: A wild cousin of the custard apple, its knobbly yellow fruit is one of the best-loved snacks of the coastal bush.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa porini wa mtopetope, tunda lake la manjano lenye vinundu ni mojawapo ya vitafunio vinavyopendwa zaidi katika vichaka vya pwani.

teaser.en: Clouds of white flowers cover this small coastal tree, a quiet relative of the hibiscus and cotton.
teaser.sw: Mawingu ya maua meupe hufunika mti huu mdogo wa pwani, jamaa mtulivu wa mbugi (hibiscus) na mpamba.

teaser.en: Its two-tone flowers hang like little Chinese lanterns, pink above and yellow below.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya rangi mbili huning'inia kama taa ndogo za karatasi za Kichina, waridi juu na manjano chini.

teaser.en: Children use the dark juice of its berries as ink, and weaver birds love to settle in its branches.
teaser.sw: Watoto hutumia maji meusi ya matunda yake kama wino, na manyanje (ndege wafumaji) hupenda kutua katika matawi yake.

teaser.en: Burn this shrub as firewood, it is said, and the family will quarrel until the homestead breaks apart.
teaser.sw: Inasemekana ukikichoma kichaka hiki kama kuni, familia itagombana hadi boma lisambaratike.

teaser.en: A modest coastal shrub that does many jobs at once: medicine, firewood, building poles and a patch of shade.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha kawaida cha pwani kinachofanya kazi nyingi kwa wakati mmoja: dawa, kuni, nguzo za ujenzi na kivuli.

teaser.en: Small yellow star-shaped flowers mark this bush shrub, one of the most popular medicines among the Digo.
teaser.sw: Maua madogo ya manjano yenye umbo la nyota hukitambulisha kichaka hiki cha vichakani, mojawapo ya dawa maarufu zaidi miongoni mwa Wadigo.

teaser.en: Children hunt its masses of tiny white berries, while their parents cut its twigs to build granaries and fish traps.
teaser.sw: Watoto huwinda matunda yake madogo meupe yaliyosongamana, huku wazazi wao wakikata vitawi vyake kujenga vihenge na kutengeneza madema ya samaki.

teaser.en: Its name is the sound you make spitting out the seed after sucking its little yellow fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake ni sauti unayotoa ukitema mbegu baada ya kufyonza tunda lake dogo la manjano.

teaser.en: Flip a leaf of this bush tree and it flashes silver, lined with fine veins as neat as ruled paper.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani la mti huu wa vichakani nalo litang'aa kama fedha, likiwa na mishipa membamba iliyopangika kama mistari ya daftari.

teaser.en: One of the rarest plants of the Shimba Hills, this small forest tree grows almost nowhere else.
teaser.sw: Mmojawapo wa mimea adimu zaidi ya Shimba Hills, mti huu mdogo wa msituni hauoti karibu popote pengine.

teaser.en: Long before toothpaste, coastal people cleaned their teeth with a chewed twig from this tree, and many still do.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla ya dawa ya meno, watu wa pwani walisafisha meno yao kwa kijiti kilichotafunwa cha mti huu, na wengi bado hufanya hivyo.

teaser.en: Children on the coast know this spiny bush for its small black berries, sweet enough to be worth a scratch or two.
teaser.sw: Watoto wa pwani wanakijua kichaka hiki chenye miiba kwa matunda yake madogo meusi, matamu kiasi cha kustahili mkwaruzo mmoja au miwili.

teaser.en: When a stomach ache is blamed on someone's evil look, this spiny bush shrub is the remedy people reach for.
teaser.sw: Maumivu ya tumbo yanaposhukiwa kusababishwa na jicho baya la mtu, kichaka hiki chenye miiba ndicho dawa ambayo watu hukimbilia.

teaser.en: Its flowers look like single white roses, and its hard, shiny fruits were once hollowed out as snuff boxes.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yanafanana na waridi jeupe la porini, na matunda yake magumu yanayong'aa zamani yalitobolewa kutengeneza vibweta vya tumbaku ya kunusa.

teaser.en: It looks like a palm but belongs to a plant line older than the dinosaurs, and its seeds once fed people in famine.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na mmea wa jamii ya mnazi, lakini ni wa ukoo wa mimea wa zamani kuliko dinosaria, na mbegu zake ziliwahi kuwalisha watu wakati wa njaa.

teaser.en: Its sweet little fruits are a treat, but carvers prize it more for hard wood that becomes combs, spoons and fishing rods.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake madogo matamu ni kitamu, lakini wachongaji huuthamini zaidi kwa mbao zake ngumu zinazogeuzwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na fimbo za kuvulia samaki.

teaser.en: Its name means 'to calm', and it is used to settle quarrels between lovers as well as to treat malaria.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kutuliza', na hutumika kusuluhisha ugomvi kati ya wapenzi pamoja na kutibu malaria.

teaser.en: Every Digo kitchen needs a *mwiko* for stirring ugali, and this bush shrub is named as the maker of them.
teaser.sw: Kila jiko la Kidigo linahitaji *mwiko* wa kusongea ugali, na kichaka hiki cha porini kimepewa jina kama mtengenezaji wake.

teaser.en: Its oily orange fruits were once threaded onto sticks and burned as candles.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye mafuta ya rangi ya chungwa zamani yalitungwa kwenye vijiti na kuwashwa kama mishumaa.

teaser.en: It looks like the garden egg's wild twin, but its round yellow fruits are not eaten.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na pacha wa porini wa ngogwe, lakini matunda yake ya mviringo ya manjano hayaliwi.

teaser.en: Its wood is hard enough for bows, clubs and arrows, and soft enough to spin into fire by friction.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kutengeneza pinde, marungu na mishale, na laini kiasi cha kupekecha moto kwa msuguano.

teaser.en: Bright yellow flowers light up the dry bush in the cool season, and its roots are one of the best-known Digo remedies.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano angavu hung'arisha vichaka vikavu wakati wa baridi, na mizizi yake ni mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zinazojulikana zaidi.

teaser.en: The Digo call it the 'chicken killer', a blunt warning about the poison in this fragrant-flowered shrub.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanauita 'muua kuku', onyo la wazi kuhusu sumu iliyo katika kichaka hiki chenye maua yenye harufu nzuri.

teaser.en: Traps made from this shrub are said to be so strong that a caught animal rots before it can break free.
teaser.sw: Mitego inayotengenezwa kwa kichaka hiki inasemekana kuwa imara kiasi kwamba mnyama aliyenaswa huoza kabla hajaweza kujinasua.

teaser.en: Convulsions were blamed on a bird called *pungu*, and this aromatic shrub was said to drive it away.
teaser.sw: Degedege ililaumiwa kwa ndege aitwaye *pungu*, na kichaka hiki chenye harufu kilisemekana kumfukuza.

teaser.en: Its fruit is much loved, yet pole cutters will not build with it, for fear it brings trouble into the home.
teaser.sw: Tunda lake linapendwa sana, lakini wakataji nguzo hawajengi nao, kwa hofu kwamba huleta matatizo nyumbani.

teaser.en: Sticks from this shrub catch octopus on the reef, but burn it at home and, it is said, you risk leprosy.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vya kichaka hiki hutumika kukamata pweza kwenye miamba ya matumbawe, lakini ukikichoma nyumbani, inasemekana unajiweka hatarini kupata ukoma.
